title: Touring to Long Beach and the Conn Wonderhorn
summary: A band member was left in hospital in California; he met the Wonderhorn maker and says he prefers Conn horns.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: We had to leave Dominic there. We left Dominic there until we got to Long Beach. They kept him in the hospital two weeks. I can't think of that band leader's name, one of the greatest men there was. Then I had the pleasure of shaking hands with the man that made C.G. Conn's first Wonderhorn. That was, uh, the man had the band in Long Beach.
Yeah, I can't think of his name now. But he was the man that made the Wonderhorn.
What kind of a horn do you like best? Well, C.G.
Conn. Conn most of the time. Yeah. C.G. Conn's first time. I had the horn stolen from me here. Oh, wow.
So I'm using El, uh, Selma now.
Did you always use the cornet or did you change the trumpet?
